title: Summit 超級電腦架構
summary: 以Summit 的 POWER9、V100 與異質計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect summit power9, v100 and heterogeneous computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

stages.title: 歷史與節點
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「歷史與節點」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop history and nodes through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 歷史架構：原理與架構

steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for historical architecture.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for historical architecture. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Summit is a historical POWER9/V100 system case. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw an original node diagram from public descriptions.
